About this item

  • 𝐀𝐥𝐥-𝐢𝐧-𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐃𝐨𝐜𝐤 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬-𝐅𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 - The upgraded dock automatically empties dust into a sealed 2.7L bag that lasts 7–9 weeks, while 75°C high-temperature self-cleaning helps refresh the mops after each use and 45°C warm air drying keeps them ready for the next clean, making everyday floor care effortless for busy and pet-friendly homes
  • 𝟏𝟖,𝟓𝟎𝟎 𝐏𝐚 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐒𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 - Engineered for strong everyday cleaning performance, the robot delivers powerful suction to effortlessly lift dust, crumbs, cat litter, stubborn debris, and pet hair from hard floors, carpets, and corners, helping keep every room fresh and spotless with less effort

  • 𝐒𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐌𝐨𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐃𝐚𝐢𝐥𝐲 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬 - From kitchen splashes and cereal crumbs to pet paw prints and everyday footprints, the advanced dual mop system tackles daily messes with ease while adjusting water flow for cleaner, fresher floors throughout your home
  • 𝐒𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐎𝐛𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐯𝐨𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 & 𝟑.𝟖 𝐢𝐧 𝐋𝐨𝐰-𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 - Powered by smart obstacle detection, the robot precisely avoids shoes, toys, and furniture legs while gliding smoothly under beds and sofas to clean hidden dust in low-clearance spaces for more complete coverage
  • 𝐂𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐩𝐞𝐭 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐦 - The robot automatically adapts to different carpet types with boosted suction, 10 mm mop lifting, and customized cleaning modes, helping protect carpet fibers while delivering deeper cleaning performance on rugs and carpeted areas
  • 𝐓𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐞-𝐇𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 - With AI-powered Roborock SmartPlan 2.0, cleaning settings automatically adjust based on your home layout, floor types, and cleaning history. Enjoy powerful cleaning at 55 dB noise level, making it ideal for homes with children, pets.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

  • Florin
    5 out of 5 stars
    Fantastic robot at the price point of ~400. Downsides are minor and easy to work around.
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 25 April 2026
    Colour Name: Black01
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Let me start by saying that I do NOT consider this to be a "perfect" robot cleaner. However, at the price point (of ~400 GBP), I find it to be fantastic.

    I've been using this for roughly 3 months now in a 2 bedroom flat

    The up-sides:

    - The suction power is good. While it doesn't ALWAYS get everything, it consistently makes both floors and carpets look fantastic.

    - The APP is intuitive. Bar a few minor things, I've found the app easy to use and never lacking in any functionality I wished for.

    - The mopping works. I've used the suggested Roborock cleaning solution and the floors look great - but I've not had any major spills to test it against just yet.

    - The mapping is great. I added some manual adjustments to the generated maps but they were ~90% correct. One thing to note is that due to it's LiDar design, it does NOT like full-height windows - it thinks of them as entrances to new rooms. A dedicated "no-entry" line in the app prevented most issues though.

    - It does not need a lot of maintenance. I run it once every 2-3 days and even so, I've had to replace the water in it only every 2-3 weeks.

    - It does a good job working around tall obstacles, like chairs and table feet. It does a full circle around them to try and catch most dust and crumbs

    - It succeeds at going underneath low furniture, like the TV stand and the couch. Entusiastically so too.

    - The mop drying feature works great. Just mind the fact that if you do a mopping job immediately followed by a SEPARATE vacuuming job, it does not resume mop drying. You have to turn on mop drying manually after.

    The downsides:

    - It can struggle with lightweight rugs. I had to put anti-slip rubber feet on mine, but that's a quick job.

    - As mentioned, it does NOT always pick up everything. However, what it doesn't catch the first time, it usually picks up the second.

    - Again, due to the LiDar design, it doesn't like SHORT obstacles. Slippers, for example, are this robot's nr.1 public enemy. Same applies to other thin/small obstacles, like cables. Either put them away or dedicate a no-go zone around them (I did that for the cables behind the TV stand and it has thus far respected it successfully).

    Overall, at this price point, I find it to be a fantastic cleaning robot that has exceeded my expectations. Are there better? For sure. Do I feel the need for better? Not at all.

    Definitely worth it!
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 18 April 2026
    Colour Name: Black01

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    I’ve waited a few weeks before reviewing so I could give a balanced assessment after the first flush of excitement had worn off. Bottom line, I love my robot vac. It has exceeded my expectations.

    It was incredibly easy to set up, mapped my floors quickly and accurately and within an hour I had it set up with routines and a schedule of cleaning types and times. It does an intensive mop and vac of my whole downstairs (35m2 it informs me) in 50 minutes - which uses about 30% of its charge.

    I have a mix of wood, natural stone and rugs and it does all of these well. I have it clean high traffic areas daily and do a deep vac and mop once a week. I’ve taken the ‘little and often’ approach rather than let dirt and dust build up. My floors have never looked as clean - including under the furniture and round the legs of chairs etc. it copes well with transitions between rooms, managing the thresholds, which in my old house are uneven and some a good centimetre high. It also copes well with rugs, corners and is surprisingly good at dealing with the dining room table and chairs obstacle course.

    The only thing I haven’t mastered is how to do a one off clean of a room in anything other than the default vac and mop mode. So far, I’ve replaced the water and emptied the dirty water once a week (I refresh the mops at the same time).

    It’s really quiet and I hardly notice it even when in the same room when it is doing its thing. The app is excellent - live tracking its progress is kind of fun!

    I was sceptical that this would remove the need for me to do the hoovering - it has. I love it (so much that it is now a she and she has a name!). Hidden benefit - there seems to be less dust since the floors are so clean, so other house working tasks have reduced a bit too. I’m not sure I’d go so far as to say life changing, but this morning at sat with a cuppa and watched my lounge be hoovered and it was wonderful! Highly recommended.

    We bought the Roborock Qrevo S Pro having returned a Shark robot vacuum and mop which didn't live up to expectations.

    The robot quickly maps your home and updates the map each time it goes out to clean.

    It effectively identifies different floor surfaces meaning it knows where to vacuum and mop and where to just vacuum. It both vacuums and mops well.

    Apart from when emptying at the end of the cycle, the robot is very quiet and unobtrusive. It does talk to you - for example to tell you it is emptying or starting to charge - which I find irritating. I am sure there is a way to stop the announcements but I haven't found it yet.

    Which brings to me to the one small reservation about this vacuum - the app.

    This works - it is OK, but it is not intuitive. It took a little while to work out how to use it as functions aren't always where you expect them to be. 'Routines' where you set the parameters for the cleaning session ie just vacuum or

    So does it do the job? Absolutely!

    Having had it operating for a week now the difference in our carpets is amazing - we never realised they were so dirty!

    We love it!

    Worth the money for the convenience and features

    I must admit I was sceptical about getting a robot vacuum, but I have a dog that likes to spread her black hair around and I don't enjoy the daily lugging around of the vacuum. Cost has always been holding me back as when you already have a decent vacuum getting a little robotic one seems more of an indulgence than a necessity - and to be honest I think it is.

    I got this for the ground floor of the house - kitchen, hallway and living room. Only the living room is carpeted, and the others are laminate flooring or lino. You are advised to run a vacuum clean routine three times before any mopping from the little robot and that makes sense as you basically need a clean floor.

    I was impressed by the fast mapping of the rooms - I did have to move a few cables and reroute them so they would not get in the way. This is not something you use if you leave stuff laying around on the floor really. Whilst it will try to avoid objects it will have issues with small things and so keep that in mind.

    I quickly set up the vacuum in the app that the manufacturer provides and configured settings for overnight charging (as it is cheaper for me) and a few other things. Then I was able to add the vacuum into Apple HomeKit so I can manage it with the rest of my home things - that’s a real bonus.

    So how is the actual cleaning?

    It's good! Great in fact.

    The vacuum did leave behind dog hair during the first three advisory runs, but I expected that - it picked up the hair from under stuff I did not normally vacuum. Simple enough just to pick it up by hand. After that no hair was left behind. The mopping is good it maintains the look of the hallway and kitchen without me having to think about it really.

    As this is a robot vacuum it is not possible for it to fit right into all the tight spaces and corners so you will have to be prepared to manually clean those first and then as and when needed.

    Currently I have my robot set to vacuum and then mop each morning, do a vacuum in the afternoon and a final vacuum and mop at night. This is probably far too much, and I will adjust it down to exclude the final vacuum and mop. The overnight charge lasts for all the cleaning, but I do not live in a mansion so your experiences may not be the same as mine.

    It's also almost silent until it zaps up speed and suction when it hits the carpet but even then, the noise level is not that much. My black labrador is not that impressed by the new addition though as it is doing a great job cleaning up all those hairs she drops over the place.

  • A N.
    5 out of 5 stars
    Excellent features at a more reasonable price
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 4 July 2026
    Colour Name: Black01
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    The S5V is an excellent machine, it's been a big help for my elderly parents, keeping carpeted and tiled floors alike clean. For the money, the features available really are good, and I have spent an inordinate amount of time researching this topic.

    Pros:

    - Great suction

    - The "duo-divide" main brush really does well at keeping cat hair and human hair off the brush, as well as general vacuuming. The side brush is similarly good with this. I have been using it over a month and haven't seen a single hair, it's genuinely impressive.

    - The mop works very well. The machine is weighty, which I think adds helpful pressure to the mop pads.

    - The extending mop pad cleans up against walls and large objects well.

    - The dock automations are great. It vacuums the robot's dustbin in about 10 seconds. It cleans and dries the mop pads very well, so no bad smelling mops to worry about.

    - Straightforward to maintain.

    - The navigation is effective. It maps out floorplans well, cleans efficiently, and can figure out where it is.

    - Scheduling is superb. I've set it up to vacuum and mop at night, which it reliably does, so everyone wakes up to clean floors in the morning.

    - The mobile app is very good (if you like mobile apps). Lots of customisations are available, it gives reports on cleaning runs that even show you precisely where it has and hasn't been, and can alert you to any issues.

    Middling points:

    - It relies heavily on the mobile app. That's not an issue for me, and it'll work with minimal fuss once set up, but just one to be aware of, if you're setting it up for people who are less keen on app usage. Also there are start, stop and go-home buttons on top, that will work just fine too.

    - No camera on the front. Personally I prefer that for privacy reasons, but it has some drawbacks in obstacle avoidance.

    - If you vaccum and mop in one run, at the end it might empty the bin on the robot but neglect to wash and dry the mops. Easy to rectify (just vacuum first and mop second as separate actions when setting up runs).

    - Depending on how heavily used it is, you'll want to clean the dock mop wash plate from time to time. It's a quick and easy job though.

    Drawbacks:

    - Obstacle avoidance is a bit limited. It detects larger objects just fine, but smaller ones, it might have to bump into. Not a major thing in my view, just keep things like cords, shoelaces, low lying cat bowls etc either off the floor or set up keep out zones in the app so it avoids them.

    - No extending sidebrush! If it had this it'd be even better. As it is, it can't brush right into 90 degree corners.

    - It cleans the perimeter of rooms once, then focuses more heavily on the rest of the floor. It'd be nice if it cleaned perimeters a bit more, though it does a pretty good job even with just a single pass. My understanding is all Roborock machines do this by default, but I haven't tried them all.

    5 out of 5 stars
    davvero un alleato nelle pulizie!
    Reviewed in Italy on 21 December 2025
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Ho acquistato il Roborock QV 35A per rendere le pulizie quotidiane molto più semplici visto che lavoro tutto il giorno,

    e devo dire che ne sono davvero soddisfatta. Questo robot aspirapolvere-lavapavimenti è diventato un punto fermo della mia routine domestica grazie alle sue prestazioni solide e intuitive.

    Potente aspirazione e pulizia profonda

    La potenza di aspirazione da 8000 Pa è impressionante: rimuove facilmente polvere, briciole, peli di animali e sporco più ostinato da pavimenti, piastrelle e tappeti. La combinazione di aspirazione e lavaggio lascia il pavimento visibilmente più pulito.

    🌀 Tecnologia antigroviglio davvero efficace

    La spazzola principale e quella laterale sono progettate per evitare l’aggrovigliamento di peli e capelli, riducendo molto la manutenzione e risparmiando tempo prezioso.

    Navigazione intelligente LiDAR e controllo app

    La mappatura degli ambienti è molto precisa grazie alla tecnologia LiDAR: il robot capisce dove si trova, evita ostacoli e segue percorsi di pulizia ottimali. Con l’app si possono impostare facilmente programmi, zone da pulire e aree da evitare.

    Stazione tutto-in-uno super pratica

    La base di ricarica è un grande vantaggio: svuota automaticamente la polvere, riempie l’acqua, lava e asciuga i panni usati, così il robot è sempre pronto per la prossima pulizia senza dover intervenire spesso.

    ✔️ Facile da usare – sia per chi è alle prime armi con i robot aspirapolvere, sia per chi cerca comodità

    ✔️ Perfetto per case con animali o pavimenti misti

    ✔️ Risultati costanti e affidabili

    In sintesi, questo modello offre pulizia potente, tecnologia intelligente e manutenzione minima: lo consiglio a chiunque voglia un robot efficiente che semplifichi davvero le pulizie di casa!
